scope: Post-correction own-method study. Keep source diversity, paired robustness, discretization, runtime, native planning and kinematic closed loops separate. No external comparison or new PhysX result.

revision.reason: Expanded roads exposed one query 1.5185 micrometers outside the measured hull, rounded by float32 to 0.0284 micrometers. Preserve the original float64 physical query for hull gating; GPU regression arithmetic is unchanged.
revision.archive: log/comprehensive_v4_20261015 retains 3055 completed conditions, failed check, frozen sources and old protocol. Do not merge these partial runs into R1 counts.
revision.rerun: All predeclared cases are rerun; reuse only immutable source geometries, masks and seeds, never select cases by outcome. No threshold relaxation.

public.reference: 300 new generated geometries, 100 SuMa road submaps across 11 sequences, 100 reused indoor inputs across 49 layouts. Sparse public reference is a proxy; no score-based exclusion.

mechanism.pairing: Same geometry, deletion, standardized Z noise and reference within each noise triplet. GP noise model stays 0.02m; risk variance follows known injected noise. Flat trials form one geometry group.

discretization.scope: Dense analytic measurements to occupancy/BGK/SEB, no GP, zero injected noise. Same 121 physical centers and 72 headings for every setting; coarse layer selected by containing bin.

scaling.scope: Synchronized BgkSebEstimator.compute wall clock with transfers and copies; nine workloads on shared desktop GPU, no concurrent experimental jobs. Not ROS latency.

planning.scope: Actual executePlannerJob queries, dense independent geometry validation, new measured-only maps. Timing repeats are not extra independent queries.

navigation.scope: Production callbacks, current obstacles and first-order bicycle plant; not PhysX/contact, SLAM/DDS concurrency or dynamic-map ghost clearing.

gates.interpretation: Engineering screens, not standards or physical certification. No post-result threshold selection; empty acceptance is not success.

statistics.unit: Geometry/source group, not cells, headings, masks or repeats. Roads have 11 groups, indoor 49. Pooled confusion counts are separate from equal-group estimates.
statistics.paired_noise: Within-geometry difference against zero noise, cluster bootstrap. Not external-method comparison or significance over correlated poses.
statistics.precision: Cumulative mean CI width is descriptive, not a post-hoc stopping rule; all prescribed samples retained.

interpretation: GP diagnostics use defaults 384 train/96 inducing. Navigation uses measured-only surface, refinement/completion off; no navigation gain attributed to unused GP output.
